lead.event: IDX's HSC review and related index adjustments, including DGWG's shareholder response
lead.headline: IDX removes 383 HSC stocks from IHSG calculation through 29 January 2027
lead.blurb: The IDX removed the stocks from IHSG calculation from 13 November 2026 through 29 January 2027 to limit volatility and passive-investor tracking errors. Delta Giri Wacana controlling shareholder David Yaory sold about 5.26 million shares at Rp260-262 each between 6 and 9 November, raising Rp1.37 billion and lifting free float to 15% to meet the IDX minimum. The IDX says HSC classification is a transparency indicator, not inherently a regulatory violation, and revised LQ45 and IDX80 constituents after input on 300 HSC stocks.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

other.event: Fitch downgrades BUMA and DOID debt ratings over liquidity risks
other.headline: Fitch downgrades DOID to CC(idn) and BUMA to CCC-(idn)
other.blurb: Fitch cited liquidity pressure and high refinancing risk at BUMA, whose roughly USD66 million in cash at September-end was insufficient to cover about USD200 million of obligations due through September 2027. BUMA faces a further IDR201 billion payment on 28 December, while Fitch said DOID had a similar credit profile.

other.event: Commercial Court declares TOPS bankrupt after revoking its peace agreement
other.headline: Commercial Court declares TOPS bankrupt after canceling debt accord
other.blurb: The Commercial Court at the Central Jakarta District Court canceled Totalindo Eka Persada’s debt-restructuring peace agreement in a 5 November ruling following creditor Sutoyo’s petition. The company received notice on 9 November and is reviewing legal steps, while acknowledging material uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern.

deals_control.headline: IDEA shareholders approve Nawasena's 66.58% acquisition
deals_control.blurb: The transaction covers 707.32 million shares at Rp53.73 each, for about Rp38 billion, giving Nawasena majority ownership. The meeting also approved changes to Idea Indonesia's board and an amendment to its business classification.

deals_control.event: VISI completes its acquisition of a 72.91% stake in HMBC
deals_control.headline: VISI completes acquisition of 72.91% stake in HMBC
deals_control.blurb: The purchase from Hasna Medika Utama Group closed on 30 October for Rp286 billion, covering 17,325 shares in Hasna Medika Bakti Cirebon, which manages Hasna Medika Cirebon Heart Hospital. Satu Visi Putra also issued 120.72 million shares at Rp994 each in a Rp120 billion private placement.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI's Q3 2026 results prompt MNC Sekuritas to cut its price target
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI posts Rp16.8 trillion Q3 profit as MNC Sekuritas cuts price target
earnings_guidance.blurb: MNC Sekuritas lowered its target despite BRI's earnings beat. BRI's September non-performing loan ratio was 2.85%, down from 2.9% in June, while its January-September net profit reached Rp47.7 trillion, 80% of MNC Sekuritas' and consensus projections for 2026.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: BRI's September 2026 non-performing loan ratio was 2.85%, down from 2.9% in June 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS to hold and cuts target price to Rp310
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia cut its target from Rp760, citing limited upside as the stock nears fair value. The broker projects net profit to rise 133% to US$81 million in 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: INCO reports a Q3 2026 net profit surge
earnings_guidance.headline: INCO reports Q3 net profit up 182% to US$147 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Vale Indonesia's revenue rose 27% to US$896 million, supported by nickel matte production of 18,341 metric tons and higher sales from the Bahodopi and Pomalaa blocks. It spent US$95 million on capital expenditure in the first nine months and held US$247 million in cash and equivalents at 30 September.

earnings_guidance.event: PTBA receives MNC Sekuritas forecast and target revisions
earnings_guidance.headline: MNC Sekuritas raises PTBA's 2026 profit forecast 51% to Rp6 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker also issued new price targets and projects Rp7.1 trillion in 2027 net profit. PTBA reported Rp1.8 trillion in Q3 net profit and Rp4.4 trillion from January to September. The outlook is supported in part by management's target to reduce domestic sales to about 34% by year-end amid potential DMO rule changes.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Gold plans a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS plans a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The new shares would equal 10% of placed and paid-up capital, at a nominal Rp150 each and fully paid. Proceeds are allocated approximately 25% to working capital, 50% to business development and 25% to refinancing or settling obligations, subject to shareholder approval on 26 November.
